title: 1900. Cloud Resource Allocation Manager
description:
Resource Allocation Manager
60
Medium
Topics
Cloud Resource Allocation Manager
Problem Statement
A cloud provider manages N servers.
Each server initially has 1 unit of free CPU resource.
The system must efficiently process up to 10^5 operations.
Operations:
1. ALLOCATE L R
→ Allocate (reduce by 1) CPU resources from server L to R.
2. DEALLOCATE L R
→ Free (increase by 1) CPU resources from server L to R.
3. QUERY L R
→ Return total free CPU resources in range L to R.
Constraints:
1 ≤ N ≤ 10^5
1 ≤ Operations ≤ 10^5
Use efficient data structure.
Input Format
N Q
Q lines of operations
Output Format
For every QUERY operation, print result.
Sample Input
5 5
QUERY 1 5
ALLOCATE 1 3
QUERY 1 5
DEALLOCATE 2 3
QUERY 1 5
Sample Output
5
2
4
Explanation
Initial: [1 1 1 1 1] → Sum = 5
After allocate 1–3 → [0 0 0 1 1] → Sum = 2
After deallocate 2–3 → [0 1 1 1 1] → Sum = 4
